title: RSS 2.0 specification
note: Item pubDate is the item publication date. RSS date-times follow RFC822 with two- or four-digit years; channel dates are not an item fallback.

title: RFC 5322 date and time semantics
note: Date validation and explicit offsets; negative zero indicates UTC with unknown source timezone; two-digit years use 00-49 plus 2000 and 50-99 plus 1900. This adapter implements only a bounded subset.

title: NASA official Image of the Day RSS feed
note: One retained public capture has 60 publication dates at minute precision and explicit GMT. Offline replay only; no complete history or UI acceptance.
